entries.final_answer: Asserted identity or refuse: reviewer = --reviewer/--agent, else the in_review claimant; never git user.name, never a synthetic token. Unforced approval with no identity refuses with a new refusal code. Forced approval records the forcing actor with the existing force-override reference. No events-schema change.
entries.question: What does an approval record when move-task has no reviewer identity?
entries.rationale: Operator ruling 2026-11-12; null reviewer needs a spec-kitty-events release (ReviewVerdict.reviewer min_length=1 + 4 core validators).

entries.final_answer: Refuse: an unforced in_review->approved must come from the in_review claimant; otherwise refuse with a new code whose remedy re-claims via agent action review <WP> --agent <id>. Forced moves stay possible and are recorded as forced, never as a review.
entries.question: How is an approver differing from the in_review claimant handled (#7573)?

entries.final_answer: Adopt + verify: adopt an approved review-cycle artifact written after the current in_review claim instead of writing N+1; otherwise write as today. A review-cycle:// --approval-ref or a note citing cycle N must resolve to an existing artifact, else refuse naming the missing path. No backfill of append-only event logs; follow-up issue for a doctor/flag report.
